result.title: Meta-Frieren: Beyond Single Level Online Learning
result.summary: We study a two-stage online optimization problem: at each round, a meta-learner first selects an agent-environment pair, then the chosen agent interacts with the environment, and receives a reward. We introduce Meta-Frieren, a general framework for maximizing cumulative reward in this setting. Our analysis yields a simple UCB-style criterion for meta-level selection and recovers prior guarantees as special cases while extending them to broader settings. We instantiate Meta-Frieren with GP-UCB under Bayesian and frequentist assumptions. We also derive, to our knowledge, the first high-probability regret bound for Feel-Good Thompson Sampling, specialize it to finite and parametric function classes, and integrate it into Meta-Frieren. Experiments support our theoretical results and demonstrate that Meta-Frieren can be successfully applied to hyperparameter optimization across multiple model classes.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究两阶段在线优化：meta-learner 每轮先选一个 agent-environment 组合，再由该 agent 与环境交互并获得奖励；作者提出 Meta-Frieren 框架，给出 UCB 式元层选择准则，并在 Bayesian 与 frequentist 假设下用 GP-UCB 实例化，还给出 Feel-Good Thompson Sampling 的高概率 regret 界，实验用于多模型类的超参优化。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「上层用 bandit 准则选择下层执行者并据反馈更新」的结构，可能为 LVR 中动态选择推理算子、计算预算或停止决策的元层控制提供问题表述与评价线索，但与原论文的视觉推理任务相距较远，需核查可迁移性。
